leftEvidence.title: Solomon sits on David’s throne and the kingdom is established

points.label: Royal moment
points.left: The first passage narrates accession and consolidation.
points.right: The second addresses a king after accumulated covenant violation.

points.label: Cause and outcome
points.left: Establishment follows David’s death and succession conflict.
points.right: Division is attributed to disobedience, with a retained tribe named.

payload.posture: Hold the two Scripture sources together while preserving the distinct human, divine, narrative, parabolic, communal, or future group of each Kingdom statement.

rightEvidence.title: Solomon’s disobedience is followed by an announced tearing of the kingdom

payload.tension: The shared Kingdom word creates a real connection, but the speaker, object of rule, action, audience, and temporal setting may differ.
payload.title: The kingdom established / the kingdom torn
